_note: The first device run. It measured a FAILURE: proot 5.1.107.98 has no -e option (it forwards its own environment to the guest), so every launch strategy died with 'unknown option -e' and no variant worked. It is kept because it is the report that found that, and because it shows the report machinery itself works: dated, run-id'd, with the v3 control classified as 'denied' -- the API-29+ app-home exec ban IS in force on this device, which is a real answer to one cell.
